dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure thing.

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: You certainly are very accommodating.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's get on stage.

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: Heh, too bad there's no entrance music.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I got other things to do...

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: I'll wait for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have the time right now...

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: Then I'll go find something else to do to pass the time... and wait for you.

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: I guess I'm the supporting actor this time. But it's fine, my joints are feeling more limber again.

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: It's thanks to you. Thanks for keeping me company.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't wait!

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: So what are you waiting for?

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: I lost... But my spirit remains undaunted!

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Regardless, you're a worthy opponent.

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Ready to spar with me?

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: After seeing how seriously Fourmon and Meilhat are taking the performance, I couldn't help but get complacent with my training, I feel like my joints have stiffened up...

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: So how about acting out a scene with me?

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: Of course, I'm referring to acting on the stage of the Pankration Ring.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You arrive at their invitation...

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: Ready for a scene with me?

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: You stand out too much for me to not invite you.

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Spar me! I'll show you how hard me and my fists are!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Go ahead, make a move.

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: Don't mind if I do.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't have the time right now...

dialogues.speaker: Goncourt
dialogues.text: You're always booked, like the hottest act in town. It's okay, I'll wait till you're free.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I got other things to do...

dialogues.speaker: Roussimoff
dialogues.text: I'll wait for you here.
